# Kamunity MPA — public guide

This site is a public demonstration and entry point for connected Kamunity tools. It is hosted at https://kamunity-org-mpa.netlify.app/ and is separate from the predecessor site at kamunity.org. A future domain change is not assumed.

## Main pages

- / — overview, selected tools, public news and room cards, services and email contact
- /news — public community-sector news cards
- /warehouse — curated catalogue of Kamunity resources and third-party options
- /my-kamunity — description of the Ring Zero approach
- /about — background
- /constitution — current public constitution page
- /bothy-floor — explanation of the internal Bothy approach

Selected tools and printable handouts are linked from the Warehouse. Third-party links are independent services: check their current features, privacy terms and prices directly.

Public Kai and Reflection chat are not available through this MPA. The Kai handout describes a proposed capability, not an available chat service. The separate Reflection site is linked on its own terms. Contact is by email only: mike@kamunityconsulting.com. Do not email sensitive client case details.

GGA is linked only as a historical example. Mycelium is a retired direction and is not part of this public catalogue.

This file describes intended public content. It does not certify that every external link, live feed or claim has completed final release acceptance.
